purpose: Machine-readable formal-build integration contract ensuring the corrected woody geometry/metric bark-UV pass is actually present in the candidate that proceeds through foliage optics and native-4K capture. This contract awards zero Visual Fidelity points; rendered evidence remains authoritative.

formalBuildChain.reason: The tree-detail rebuild regenerates the generated woody hierarchy. Woody continuity therefore must run after that rebuild and before morphology/foliage optics are sealed into the formal scene. Validation must transitively re-check woody continuity whenever foliage optics is validated by the formal capture chain.

secondary/twig diameter remains subordinate to the parent branch
stock primitive woody renderers are not accepted as final visible benchmark art
